body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-07-31 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "It will be a mix of internal accruals and term loan ... maybe this year could be maybe 60% debt and 40% internal accruals" Metric: Capex funding mix. Target: no equity; ~60:40 debt:accruals. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: partly. Evidence: FY26 borrowings +INR 220 cr against ~INR 272 cr investing outflow: ~80% debt-funded, not 60%. Then equity in FY27 repaid debt.
